title: One week. A traceable scientific story.
description: Live VISTA skills walk existing HEADWATER evidence for one issued week. Figures and numbers are read from saved project files.

requiredSkills.description: Read the literature shelf for gaps left open by the ledger.
Report what is already local; no live ERA5 download.
Read scored, closed and blocked experiment records.
Show open rows without launching work.
Propose a ledger-grounded protocol for human review.
Display the existing command; do not execute it.
Read saved 9×9 predictions and ERA5 runoff; write the case figure.
Read the frozen Trial 0 comparison with bilinear.

optionalSkill.description: Read one agreed fill/hold rule from the realization file.
